text: Sources agree that the sealed Nevada probate ruling against Rupert Murdoch's trust amendment ran 96 pages, that Fox Corp. announced the settlement on September 8, 2025, that the settlement giving Lachlan Murdoch control of the family media assets was $3.3 billion, that Rupert Murdoch announced on September 21, 2023 he was stepping down as chairman of Fox and News Corp, and that the new Murdoch trust holds about 33% of News Corp's Class B shares after the settlement. Sources disagree only on the precision of that shareholding figure, with some citing 33.1% and others rounding to 33%. No contradiction on a date or number was found in this run.
